legal.title: Legal & policies
legal.intro: The rules behind your booking, in plain language. Each section covers one part of travelling with us.
legal.privacy.p1: {name} collects what a booking needs: names, contact details, passport or ID numbers where a fare requires them, and the trips themselves.
legal.privacy.p2: We use it to ticket you, check you in, keep you informed about your flight, and meet immigration and safety rules. We do not sell your personal data.
legal.privacy.p3: Records are kept only as long as bookings, tax and safety rules require, then deleted or anonymised.
legal.carriage.p1: {name} carries you under its conditions of carriage — the agreement covering fares, baggage, schedules and responsibilities when you fly.
legal.carriage.p2: The full text is available on request through the support page; this page reflects the same rules.
legal.cookies.p1: This site uses only the cookies it needs: a signed-in session cookie so your account and bookings stay private, and a small preference cookie that remembers your language.
legal.cookies.p2: There is no advertising or third-party tracking cookie. You can clear the preference cookie at any time in your browser.
legal.refunds.p1: Refundability follows your fare: Flex fares refund to the original payment method, Saver fares are not refundable, and Business fares follow the rules shown at checkout.
legal.refunds.p2: Cancellations and changes are made from your booking page. Approved refunds return to the payment method used; timing depends on your bank or M-Pesa.
legal.rewards.p1: Pride Rewards miles are earned on eligible flights and redeemed for upgrades and award travel subject to seat availability.
legal.rewards.p2: Miles have no cash value, cannot be transferred to another member, and programme terms may change with notice to members.
legal.access.p1: You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you, ask for corrections, or ask for deletion where the law allows.
legal.access.p2: Send a request from your account page — the download and deletion tools act immediately on your own record.
legal.updated: You are reading the {locale} edition; both language editions carry identical terms.
section.explore.title: Explore
section.explore.intro: Every city on our network, from home routes to long-haul connections — pick a region and start planning.
section.explore.empty: No nonstop routes here today — every journey connects through Nairobi.
section.explore.networkBody: {name} flies to {count} airports from its Nairobi hubs, linking domestic, regional and intercontinental destinations under one ticket.
section.explore.aboutP1: {name} is an airline built around one idea: the world should be within reach, with honest fares and crews who care.
section.explore.aboutP2: Today the network serves {count} airports — domestic feeders, regional trunk routes and intercontinental long-haul, all on one ticket.
section.explore.aboutP3: A modern fleet of {fleet} aircraft keeps every cabin clean, quiet and on time — from regional hops to overnight long-haul.
section.plan.title: Plan your trip
section.plan.intro: Everything to arrange before you fly — fares, documents, baggage, holidays and group travel in one place.
section.plan.holdBody: Not ready to pay? Start a booking and we'll hold the price for 24 hours while you decide — no fee, and seats release automatically if time runs out.
section.holidays.body: Holiday packages pair your seat with hotels, transfers and local tips — tell us your dates and we quote the whole trip in one reply.
section.holidays.quoteBody: Send us your dates and travellers, and we come back with flights, hotel and transfers together — one price.
section.check.documentsBody: Carry a passport valid for at least six months beyond your travel dates, plus any visa or ID your destinations require. Keep a photo of it on your phone as backup.
section.check.etaBody: Many countries clear you before you fly — apply online at least 72 hours ahead and carry the approval with your boarding pass.
section.check.healthBody: Check vaccination requirements for every country on your ticket at least three weeks before departure, and pack prescription medicines in their original packaging with a doctor note.
section.check.moneyBody: Cards are accepted on board and at our airports; carry some local currency for connections. Most countries require you to declare cash above a limit — check before you pack.
section.check.baggageBody: Your fare includes {kg} kg in the hold and one cabin bag of {carry} kg. Extra kilos are cheaper to add online before departure than at the airport.
section.check.petsBody: Pets travel in the hold as checked baggage or cargo, in an IATA-approved crate, with a current health certificate. Tell us when you book — places per flight are limited.
section.check.restrictedBody: Lithium batteries, lighters and aerosols have strict carry-on rules; sharp tools, fireworks and flammable liquids must be checked or left at home. When in doubt, check the IATA dangerous goods list before you pack.
section.check.helpBody: Our support page collects entry rules, health advice and baggage answers in one list.
section.groups.body: Travelling ten or more? Groups get coordinated seating, one invoice and a person who answers.
section.groups.tenPlusBody: One booking reference, seats together where possible, and baggage handled as one move.
section.groups.corporateBody: Monthly invoicing, traveller profiles and reporting for companies that fly often.
section.groups.studentsBody: Extra baggage and seasonal fares for students moving between home and campus.
section.manage.title: Book & manage
section.manage.intro: Find your trip, check in, change what you need and get help from real people.
section.manage.findBody: Enter your reference and last name — the same details printed on your ticket.
section.manage.tip1: Your booking reference has six characters and appears in your confirmation message.
section.manage.tip2: Changes follow your fare rules — Flex fares change freely, Saver fares do not.
section.manage.tip3: Extra baggage and seats can be added from your booking right up to departure.
section.checkin.stepSearchBody: Find the trip with your reference, or sign in to see every booking.
section.checkin.stepPassengersBody: Check names and travel documents are exactly right.
section.checkin.stepSeatsBody: Sit together, or take what is free of charge.
section.checkin.stepPassBody: Save the boarding pass to your phone or print it.
section.changes.changeBody: Self-service changes re-price the fare and keep your reference. Everything you do not touch stays exactly as booked.
section.changes.refundsBody: Flex fares refund to the original payment method; Saver fares are non-refundable, though taxes can be returned on request.
section.changes.delaysBody: If we move your flight we tell you by email and SMS, and you choose a new time or a refund. Live updates also show on the flight status page.
section.support.q1: How do I change my flight?
section.support.a1: Open your booking from the Changes tab and pick a new time — your fare rules apply.
section.support.a2: Approved refunds return to your original payment method; banks and M-Pesa take a few working days.
section.support.a3: Yes — tap pay, send the fare to the payment number shown, and paste the confirmation message you receive.
section.support.q4: How do I add extra baggage?
section.support.a4: Add it from your booking before departure — airport rates are always higher.
section.support.specialsBody: Wheelchairs, unaccompanied minors, expectant travellers, mobility help and special meals are arranged free of charge — request them while booking or up to 48 hours before departure.
section.support.paymentBody: Send the fare to the payment number below with your booking reference as the note, then paste the confirmation message you receive — your booking is confirmed on the spot.
section.support.channel1: Booking problems: open your booking and use the options inside it.
section.support.channel2: Flight day questions: check the flight status page first — gates and times update live.
section.support.channel3: Everything else: sign in and we see exactly what you see.
section.experience.title: On board
section.experience.intro: The aircraft, the cabins and the small things that make the hours pass faster.
section.experience.fleetBody: A young, efficient fleet of {count} aircraft flies every route — tap a type for specs, cabins and the registrations you will actually fly.
section.experience.cabinsBody: Four ways to fly, from the lean Saver to Business. Compare baggage, changes and comfort side by side.
section.service.mealsBody: Complimentary snacks on short hops and hot meals on longer sectors, with drinks throughout. Special meals are free if ordered 24 hours ahead.
section.service.bagsBody: One cabin bag plus a personal item — a laptop or handbag — that fits under the seat in front of you.
section.service.seatsBody: A seat pitch that respects your knees, USB power at every seat, and exit-row legroom you can book in advance.
section.service.loungeBody: Quiet seating, showers, Wi-Fi and a bite before you fly — included for Business travellers and top-tier members.
section.service.priorityBody: Dedicated check-in desks, priority boarding, and your bags off the belt first.
section.service.planetBody: Newer aircraft burn less fuel per seat, we weigh bags instead of guessing, and single-use plastic is out of every cabin.
section.rewards.title: Pride Rewards
section.rewards.intro: Miles for every flight, four tiers of benefits and rewards you can actually use.
section.rewards.aboutBody: Join free and earn miles from your first flight. Miles buy upgrades, award seats and partner rewards; status tiers add comfort to every trip after that.
section.rewards.joinBody: Membership is free, miles post automatically to your account, and one number follows you across every booking.
section.rewards.joinAside: Two minutes to sign up — and your next flight starts earning.
section.rewards.tiersBody: Qualify once a year on the miles you fly — benefits stack as you climb.
section.tier.blueP1: Miles from your very first flight
section.tier.silverP2: One extra checked bag on every trip
section.tier.goldP1: Lounge access for you and a guest
section.earn.flightsBody: Miles post after each flight, calculated from the fare you paid and the distance flown.
section.earn.partnersBody: Selected hotels, car hire and everyday partners add miles to the same account.
section.earn.rateEconomy: Economy fares: 1 mile per 100 KES spent
section.earn.rateFlex: Flex fares earn 1.5 times the miles
section.redeem.upgradesBody: Spend miles on more space — confirmed before you depart.
section.redeem.awardsBody: Book seats with miles on any route when space is free, from 15,000 miles one way.
section.redeem.faqBody: Miles post within 48 hours of flying, taxes on award tickets are paid separately, and rewards can be used for anyone you book.
section.redeem.ctaBody: Join now, or keep your rewards number handy on your next booking.
